success_requires: MLflow metadata in PostgreSQL and artifacts in MinIO verified

decision_rule.V3_EXTENSION_SUCCESS: All success requirements complete; external DocILE/REFinD access may remain human-blocked.
decision_rule.V3_EXTENSION_PARTIAL: At least API, load, fault/recovery, expanded security, and reviewer application complete, but one or more infrastructure/serving requirements are externally blocked or fail bounded pilots.
decision_rule.V3_EXTENSION_BLOCKED: The minimum operational evidence set cannot be completed.
